item.title: LP Gas Growth Summit set for Sept. 1-3 in Florida
item.description: Propane retailers and industry partners will gather for the 11th annual LP Gas Growth Summit on Sept. 1-3 at Reunion Resort, outside Orlando, Florida. <p>The post <em>LP Gas</em> Growth Summit set for Sept. 1-3 in Florida first appeared on LP Gas.</p>

item.title: Making sense of volatile crude inventories
item.description: Mark Rachal parses through the first quarter of U.S. crude inventories data. <p>The post Making sense of volatile crude inventories first appeared on LP Gas.</p>

item.title: Why additional insured provisions matter
item.description: A court decision out of Georgia highlights the importance of having contractual provisions requiring coverage as an additional insured. <p>The post Why additional insured provisions matter first appeared on LP Gas.</p>

item.title: Refocusing the propane message
item.description: Look at PERC’s expanded messaging approach and how your propane business can regain focus on what really matters to customers. <p>The post Refocusing the propane message first appeared on LP Gas.</p>

item.title: One-Tank on Pulse monitoring, safety and tech adoption in propane
item.description: One-Tank shares how its new Pulse monitoring device delivers low-cost, direct-to-satellite tank monitoring with built-in safety features, as highlighted during the 2025 LP Gas Growth Summit. <p>The post One-Tank on Pulse monitoring, safety and tech adoption in propane first appeared on LP Gas.</p>

item.title: Propane Personality: Kim Godlewski
item.description: Learn more about IPS and IPS Equipment co-owner, Kim Godlewski. <p>The post Propane Personality: Kim Godlewski first appeared on LP Gas.</p>

item.title: Otodata using telemetry to strengthen propane-customer relationships
item.description: Otodata shares how its tank telemetry helps propane marketers boost logistics, efficiency and customer retention during a conversation at the 2025 LP Gas Growth Summit. <p>The post Otodata using telemetry to strengthen propane-customer relationships first appeared on LP Gas.</p>

item.title: 2026 LP Gas Rising Leader: Johnny Thomas
item.description: Learn more about Johnny Thomas, a 2026 LP Gas Rising Leader and regional energy manager at Energy Partners Propane in Missoula, Montana. <p>The post 2026 <em>LP Gas</em> Rising Leader: Johnny Thomas first appeared on LP Gas.</p>

item.title: 13 states allow under-21 hazmat drivers for intrastate commerce
item.description: Indiana is one of 13 states that allow truck drivers to get their HME at 18 instead of 21 for intrastate commerce. <p>The post 13 states allow under-21 hazmat drivers for intrastate commerce first appeared on LP Gas.</p>

item.title: How the propane industry reflects the realities of life
item.description: Editor-in-Chief Brian Richesson shares how LP Gas magazine has always been about the propane industry. <p>The post How the propane industry reflects the realities of life first appeared on LP Gas.</p>
